title: XR in Healthcare
description: Witness the merger of innovative worlds in pain management and pediatric care within the "XR in Healthcare" session at HarvardXR. This comprehensive talk, led by pioneers Kate Donovan of Boston Children’s Hospital and Dr. John E. Rubin along with Dr. Rohan Jotwani from Weill Cornell, showcases the transformative potential of Extended Reality (XR) in reshaping healthcare practices, patient experiences, and medical education. Moderated by Casey Armstrong.
